thread:
Sam: starting rollout v2.14.0 -> eu1 30% (staggered canary) at 2026-03-21T09:20Z. will watch synthetic probes and prefills.

deploy-bot: deploy v2.14.0 to service=inference-proxy region=eu1 stage=canary status=IN_PROGRESS percent=30

Maria: seeing synth-embed checks failing in eu1 already, p95 >> baseline. grabbing logs. :warning:

deploy-bot: smoke-check synth-embed-eu1 result=FAIL metrics={p50:0.42s, p95:3.12s, error_rate:4.8%} threshold_p95=0.8s

Jordan: can you paste the error? 503s or timeouts?

Maria: mostly 503 from inference-proxy upstream. sample: ```
[2026-03-21T09:22:01Z] inference-proxy eu1 - upstream_status=503 upstream_service=model-serving exec=88ms - "POST /v1/embeddings"
[2026-03-21T09:22:01Z] kv-cache miss prefix="user:prefill"
```

Derek: interesting that exec=88ms but upstream_status=503. may be L7 or model container rejecting. any new kernel/quant changes in this build?

Sam: v2.14.0 included small tokenizer fix and a change to the routing table for embed model variants. not expected to change HTTP status but could affect model selection.

Maria: root cause hunt: model-serving logs show OOM attempts then rapid connection resets for a subset of pods. looks correlated with canary subset 3/10 pods.

Ryan: I'm oncall, pulling traces now. allocating fallback: will route eu1 embed traffic to v2.13.9 while we triage.

Sam: agree. we should hold the rollout and pin eu1 to previous stable until we fix. no global rollback yet.

Derek: proposal: hold global rollout, apply region-specific pin (traffic-split) to 100%->v2.13.9 for embed route in eu1, leave other routes alone. create incident and post release note.

Maria: +1. can we do a quick hotfix candidate? if it's a model selection bug, might be faster to revert that routing change in v2.14.1. but pin is lower blast radius now.

deploy-bot: action_required: hold rollout for v2.14.0 (eu1). commands: ```
# pin eu1 embed route to v2.13.9
redwoodctl route update --service inference-proxy --region eu1 --route embed --pin-version v2.13.9 --reason "postdeploy synth failures"
```

Sam: running the pin command now. will post confirmation when done.

Sam: done. deploy-bot: please verify traffic split.

deploy-bot: route change applied service=inference-proxy region=eu1 route=embed pinned_version=v2.13.9 status=OK

Maria: re-running synth-embed probe from CI: p95 dropping to 0.47s, error_rate ~0.5%. 👍

Ryan: good. I'm opening INC-4521 with notes, linking runbook and logs. assigning to @Jordan for triage and @Derek for rollback plan if needed.

Jordan: starting triage. will check model-serving autoscaler logs and the kernel selection change in the build.

Derek: also adding a postmortem checklist item: make canary subset determinism reproducible across infra zones. saw subset 3/10 affected.

Sam: timeline for next steps: 1) keep eu1 pinned until fix or hotfix release, 2) replicate failing pod locally with same image, 3) if fix straightforward (revert routing change), cut v2.14.1 and smoke in staging then re-rollout, 4) update release notes with incident summary and mitigation.

Maria: I'll update the internal release-notes draft with incident blurb and link INC-4521.

Ryan: notifying product and support that EU embed traffic is pinned to previous version and we may re-open tickets if customers see errors. @SupportOps FYI.

Sam: thanks everyone. holding rollout and moving to triage channel. will escalate if we see new failures outside eu1. :thumbsup:
